verbose.description: Return execution diagnostics and redundant phase detail when true. Omitted or false returns compact semantic results, preserving qualifications, references, continuation and recovery evidence.

relativePath.description: File or directory path relative to the session workspace root, such as src/main/kotlin/orders/OrderService.kt or services/orders. Use '.' for the root. Not a package name, glob, absolute path, or parent traversal.

maxDiagnostics.description: Maximum diagnostic entries to return. Omission or null selects 100. This limits results, not module admission, indexing, or compiler work; incomplete coverage remains explicit.

continuation.description: Opaque same-basis diagnostic continuation. Omit or use null to start. Resume the same relative_path; increase execution_budget if a grant cannot cross the enumeration prefix.

ExecutionBudget.description: Optional positive controls use configured defaults. BOUNDED mode clamps each control. RUNNER_CONTROLLED accepts only output controls.

maxElapsedMs.description: Elapsed allowance in milliseconds. Omission uses KAST_READ_SEMANTIC_MILLIS. Host time can reduce this grant.

maxWorkUnits.description: Accounted work allowance. Query omission uses KAST_READ_SEMANTIC_WORK. Time and response size do not change this allowance.

maxResults.description: In BOUNDED mode, this caps results. In RUNNER_CONTROLLED mode, this caps each output page.

maxReturnedBytes.description: Encoded response allowance in bytes. Omission uses KAST_READ_SEMANTIC_RETURNED_BYTES.
